name: Camp Saginaw
description_short: Family run coed overnight camp for about 400 kids ages 6 to 16 on over 400 wooded acres in southern Chester County, founded in 1927 and marking its 100th summer in 2027. Campers do athletics, arts and ceramics, two pools, a lake and Big Elk Creek, ropes and aerial courses, zip lines, dirt bikes and trips, in full, half and two week sessions.
refund_policy_summary: A $2,500 deposit at enrollment, $500 of it a non-refundable application fee; no refunds for cancellations after January 1, 2027. A first time camper who leaves early gets the unused days refunded.
notes: 2027 tuition has three tiers (early bird, standard, late spring); the page does not give the tier dates, so the standard rate is recorded. Early bird / late spring: Full Season $13,000 / $14,000; First Half $8,600 / $9,050; Second Half grades 1 to 5 $5,700 / $6,250; grades 6 to 11 $6,800 / $7,250; Two Weeks $5,000 / $5,450. Two Weeks and Rookie Day are for first time campers only. Cash or check prices; 3% card fee. Tuition includes trips, canteen, laundry and coach bus transportation. Sibling, alumni and referral discounts. Winter office in Cherry Hill, NJ.
